proves.claim: Init on a fresh repository registers it for git maintenance with the incremental strategy and prefetch off, and schedules it with git own scheduler choice.

cli.io-commands-init.registers-increment.why: Without it, a regression that leaves a managed repo with no background maintenance, so loose objects pile up and every git command slows, would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The macOS, Windows and Linux schedulers (launchctl, schtasks, a systemd timer, cron) each schedule the repo through git maintenance start --scheduler.

cli.io-commands-init.each-platform-uses-.why: Without it, a regression that schedules maintenance on one platform only would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: Init on a machine with no supported scheduler records that maintenance is not scheduled, says how to run it by hand, and still succeeds.

cli.io-commands-init.no-scheduler-record.why: Without it, a regression that fails init or stays silent where no scheduler exists would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A runner job without git test scheduler, or git with no global config, never runs git maintenance start.

cli.io-commands-init.runner-job-never-sc.why: Without it, a regression that lets a test or runner job install jobs in the machine scheduler would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: Doctor reports a managed repo with git maintenance not registered, and registering it clears the line.

cli.io-commands-doctor-toolchains.doctor.why: Without it, a regression that hides an unmaintained repo from doctor would pass unnoticed.
